title: Cosmical
summary: COSMICAL, adjective s as z. [Gr., order, the world.] 1. Relating to the world, or to the whole system of visible bodies, including the earth and stars. 2. In astronomy, rising or setting with the sun;

inlines.v: COSMICAL, adjective s as z. [Gr., order, the world.] 1. Relating to the world, or to the whole system of visible bodies, including the earth and stars. 2. In astronomy, rising or setting with the sun; not acronical.
